improvement: Ban CRPS-Sum (and any sum-inside-score metric) from GSE model selection for joint forecasts (spread+total distributions, correlated slates); use mean per-dimension CRPS + Energy Score — and institute the dummy-model discrimination test as a CI gate: every new evaluation metric must rank a known-good forecaster above (a) a marginal-matched noise forecaster and (b) a constant forecaster on backtest, or the metric is rejected; extend the protocol to economic metrics (can a degenerate always-bet-the-favorite strategy game the ROI metric?).
gate: ADOPT the guardrail iff the reproduction confirms CRPS-Sum can misrank on GSE's own joint forecasts (dummy beats or ties the real model under CRPS-Sum while losing under Energy Score); if it ranks correctly on GSE data, still adopt the ban as prophylaxis with the dummy test as an advisory check.

title: GNNRank: Learning Global Rankings from Pairwise Comparisons via Directed Graph Neural Networks
improvement: Port the transferable GNNRank components: per-week directed team matchup graph (nodes = 32 teams, edges = games through week w, weights = point/EPA differential), DIMPA-style directed GNN embeddings (d=32-64) with rest/QB node side-information, 'dist' readout, then unrolled proximal Fiedler refinement — trained with a supervised time-forward objective (backprop through the proximal steps to minimize next-week predictive log-loss) instead of the paper's in-sample upset reconstruction, benchmarked against dynamic Elo / state-space posterior.
gate: ADOPT iff ALL hold on the 2024-2025 test window: (1) calibrated win-prob log-loss beats the better of dynamic Elo/state-space by >=0.005 nats/game; (2) Brier improves by >=0.002; (3) ATS cover >=52.4% with n>=500 picks; (4) ECE within 0.01 of baseline.

title: A Statistical Model of Serve Return Impact Patterns in Professional Tennis
improvement: Build latent style allocation on NGS tracking spatial summaries (start: WR route endpoints/catch-point locations): K,M in 2..8 grid via ELPD, covariates = down/distance/formation/man-zone, player offsets eta (receiver) and delta (defender) — descriptive validity via ELPD vs finite-mixture baselines on 2024, predictive value via receiver style-membership improving completion-probability log-loss; then make styles dynamic (HMM layer over styles within a game) and defender-specific to capture in-game tendency shifts.
gate: ADOPT tracking archetypes as features iff BOTH: (a) ELPD gain over finite mixture replicates (>=2%) on 2024 NGS data, AND (b) style features improve completion-probability log-loss by >=1% on 2024; reject as engine features if (b) fails (keep as content/visualization only).

title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Regularized Wasserstein Loss
improvement: Build the joint-distribution staking policy (SinkhornDRL): weekly state from logged picks/odds, action = stake grid, critic outputs N=32 samples of the 3-dim return vector (settled profit, -max intra-week drawdown, mean CLV) with Sinkhorn divergence to the vector Bellman target; scalarize at decision time with a tunable risk price (e.g., maximize E[profit] - 2*E[drawdown] + 0.5*E[CLV]) — then learn the risk price itself as a contextual bandit over the season (meta-action from bankroll state, trained to end-of-season Sharpe).
gate: ADOPT iff on 2024 the joint policy Pareto-dominates the best scalar policy on >=2 of {ROI, max drawdown, CLV} with the third no worse than -5% relative; otherwise REJECT (compute not justified for a scalar-equivalent result).

title: TTS-GAN: Transformer-based Time-Series GAN
improvement: Adopt conditional TTS-GAN for bulk trajectory augmentation: 32-team x 18-week x K-metric panel (nflverse 2015-2024), regime class-embedding (home favorite/dog, divisional, dome, altitude, short-week) on noise + discriminator patches, 3-block transformer encoder G/D, LSGAN losses — single conditional model instead of per-class models, TSTR-driven early stopping (checkpoint maximizing synthetic-trained probe classifier's real-data accuracy), throughput >=100 trajectories/second/GPU.
gate: ADOPT iff: (a) it matches/beats Time-GAN on >=7/10 of the paper's fidelity comparisons on NFL data, (b) TSTR AUC >= 90% of real-trained AUC on held-out seasons, (c) real+synthetic spread log-loss beats real-only by >=0.003, (d) throughput >=100 trajectories/sec on one GPU.

title: Modeling the bounce of a gas-filled ball
improvement: Add weather/ball_physics.py: implement epsilon(T) (restitution coefficient vs temperature) anchored at regulation 12.5-13.5 psi at 70F, convert game-day temperature to pressure drop via the ideal gas law then to delta-epsilon, and map to kickoff/punt touchback-rate and fumble adjustments — then fit the lambda parameters from broadcast data: below-32F vs matched above-50F games (2020-2024) to produce a proprietary cold-weather ball-effects table (pressure drop -> epsilon drop -> touchback/fumble adjustments).
gate: ADOPT the epsilon(T) adjustment iff predicted delta-epsilon explains residual touchback variance with the correct sign at p < 0.05 on the 2024 holdout; either way keep the ideal-gas-law pressure correction (that's just physics).

title: Causal inference with recurrent and competing events
improvement: Stand up the recurrent/competing-events estimand taxonomy for injury analysis: total vs controlled-direct effect of high acute:chronic workload weeks on recurrent soft-tissue injury counts per player-season, with season-ending IR as the competing event (nflverse injury + snap-count workload 2018-2024); discrete-time g-formula/IPW vs a naive censor-at-IR analysis to show the estimand gap; positivity check via weight truncation [0.1, 10].
gate: ADAPT iff the NFL replication shows the naive censor-at-IR estimate and the IPW total effect differ by >=20% (competing-event distinction matters empirically) with identified positivity (no weight truncation beyond [0.1,10] needed for >95% of player-weeks); REJECT the full machinery if the difference is <10% — keep only the taxonomy as a reporting standard.

title: TransDreamer: Reinforcement Learning with Transformer World Models
improvement: Fold a transformer-state-space model (TSSM) into GSE-Dream as a backbone variant: transformer over past latent states + play descriptors (replacing the GRU transition), myopic posterior per play (no recurrent encoder — parallelizes over full game sequences), DreamerV3 categorical latents, attention conditioned on a persistent matchup embedding — plus sparse/dilated attention (full within-drive, sparse to prior-drive summary tokens) to hold near-RSSM throughput.
gate: ADOPT TSSM iff on the 2024 long-context probe it beats the RSSM by >=10% (log-likelihood of 2nd-half outcomes given 1st-half context) AND stays within 2x of RSSM sampling throughput; REJECT if throughput collapses (>4x slower per 100k-game batch) or the gain is <5%.

title: Bettors' Reaction to Match Dynamics — Evidence from In-Game Betting
improvement: Build the in-play market-sentiment monitor: Betfair Exchange NFL in-play volume per minute as target, per-drive EPA differentials as the 'momentum' signal (NFL's discrete analogue of VAEP), pre-game vig-adjusted probabilities + live WP + score diff, AR(1) sentiment state g_t with P-spline time-varying coefficients; serving = one-step-ahead relative-volume forecast and a momentum-divergence flag (market live prob vs GSE prob) — drive-level momentum vs minute-level tested head-to-head.
gate: ADAPT iff on 2024: (a) the momentum-SSM beats the no-momentum SSM on per-game log-likelihood with the second-half beta_t effect replicating the paper's shape, AND (b) the momentum-divergence rule produces positive CLV, or (c) the one-step-ahead relative-volume forecast improves RMSE by >=15%.

title: Comparison of Combination Methods to Create Calibrated Ensemble Forecasts for Seasonal Influenza in the U.S.
improvement: Add a Beta Linear Pool (BLP) post-processing layer on the engine's linear-pool consensus: per-market (spread/total/moneyline) estimate (alpha, beta) by MLE on log score over past seasons, publish B_{alpha,beta}(F_LP(y)) as the calibrated forecast — with shrinkage-regularized estimation (penalized MLE toward identity, lambda by leave-one-season-out CV) and separate (alpha,beta) for high-vs-low total regimes, attacking the paper's under-prediction pathology.
gate: ADOPT iff on the 2025 holdout it improves mean log score over the weight-optimized LP by >=0.02 AND its PIT Cramer distance is <= LP's (no calibration regression), with no systematic under-prediction (PIT CDF within +-0.05 of diagonal at all deciles).

title: Minimax Decision Rules for Planning Under Uncertainty
improvement: Adopt median-world (or trimmed-mean/top-k-dropped) regret aggregation for GSE's policy computation instead of max-world regret: generate scenario worlds via a fixed, versioned, seeded bootstrap protocol (no hand-added/removed worlds without a logged amendment), compute policies under median regret with a 75th-percentile compromise variant; monthly leave-one-world-out sensitivity audit — if dropping one world flips >20% of the policy table, flag as scenario-fragile and fall back; plus an adversarial red-team search for the world that maximally flips the policy, then harden against it.
gate: ACCEPT iff: the injection experiment confirms scenario sensitivity is real for GSE's world set (flip rate >20% under max-regret) AND median-regret cuts it by >=50% AND backtested worst-world regret is within 10% of max-regret's; REJECT if median-regret sacrifices >15% of worst-world protection.

title: Offline Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Pricing of Consumer Credit
improvement: Build the offline-CQL staking policy on GSE's logged picks/odds: state = per-bet feature vector (edge, de-vigged fair odds, market odds, CLV history, book, day-of-week, slate size, bankroll fraction), action = stake in {0, 0.25u, 0.5u, 1u, 2u}, reward = settled profit; train on 2021-2023, evaluate on realized 2024 settlement (stronger than the paper's model-only eval) plus sensitivity re-scoring under 3 alternative outcome models; trust-region constraint: stake MAPD vs historical fractional-Kelly <= 25%; then extend to sequential CQL with bankroll in state and log-bankroll-growth reward to capture stake-smoothing.
gate: ADOPT iff on realized 2024 settlement the CQL staking policy beats fractional-Kelly ROI by >=2pp with stake MAPD <= 25% AND the sensitivity re-scoring keeps the sign of the lift under all 3 outcome models; REJECT if the lift vanishes under alternative evaluators.

title: Evaluating State of the Art, Forecasting Ensembles- and Meta-learning Strategies for Model Fusion
improvement: Build three fusion candidates over GSE's constituent model probabilities per game/market: (a) FFORMA-style LightGBM meta-learner on game meta-features (spread bucket, total, market disagreement, ATS form volatility, rest, weather) with weighted log-loss objective -> softmax model weights (weights learned weeks 1-9, applied weeks 10-18); (b) small-MLP NN stack; (c) plain average — default to (a) with the paper's regime-switching selection rule, then add a second-stage market-shrinkage blender: ridge meta-regression on (market-implied prob, FFORMA blend) vs outcomes, testing a market-aware two-level fusion.
gate: ADAPT accepted iff FFORMA-style blender beats SA by >=2% relative log-loss on the 2024 walk-forward AND beats the NN-stack in >=2 of 3 markets; reject if neither beats SA by >=1.5%.

title: Skating-Mixer: Long-Term Sport Audio-Visual Modeling with MLPs
improvement: Build Game-Mixer: treat each game as a long sequence with quarters (or drives) as clips — per-quarter features (tracking aggregates, score differential, pace, injuries/lineup changes) plus a [MEM] token carrying game state (momentum, adjustments, fatigue) forward via the Memory-Mixer recurrence; final [MEM] + averaged quarter tokens predict second-half/final outcome and per-quarter WP evolution — with an event-triggered write gate so only high-leverage events (turnovers, 4th-down conversions, injuries, scores) rewrite memory, making writes interpretable game-deciding moments for content.
gate: ACCEPT iff Game-Mixer beats the memoryless baseline by >=0.02 log-loss at halftime on 2024 games AND the no-memory ablation is worse (proving the recurrence, not just features, adds value); REJECT if no gain over score-diff + EPA.

title: Bayesian Analysis of Formula One Race Results: Disentangling Driver Skill and Constructor Advantage
improvement: Build the hierarchical logistic QB/team/coach decomposition: logit P(A beats B) = (theta_QB_A + theta_team_A + ...) - (theta_QB_B + ...), cross-classified random effects for QB, head coach, offensive/defensive units + seasonal form (Stan/numpyro on 2009-2025 nflverse); identification via QB team-changes and backup-QB starts; report variance shares (QB vs roster vs coach) with CIs; add the QB x team interaction the paper assumes away as a 'scheme-fit rating' for free-agency analysis; serve the counterfactual engine P(team X with QB Y beats team Z with QB W).
gate: ADOPT iff: (a) QB/team/coach variance shares are stable across two independent fit windows (2009-2015 vs 2016-2022; same rank order, magnitudes within 50%), AND (b) on the 2023-2024 QB-change test set the decomposed model beats team-only Elo log-loss by >=1%.

title: Predicting Cricket Outcomes using Bayesian Priors (arXiv:2203.10706) — replaces [1539]
improvement: Build the opponent-specific player-distribution DFS Monte Carlo: per-player fantasy-point distributions (hierarchical Bayesian gamma with player x opponent random effects, partial pooling, fit by MCMC — fixing the paper's 'Bayesian in name only' gap) keyed to matchup tables (WR yards vs coverage-shell-specific CB history), stratified sampling -> lineup construction under salary-cap/positional constraints, 10,000+ replications per slate -> lineup score distributions and field-adjusted win probability for GPP ownership optimization; score distributions with proper scoring rules vs an Elo baseline.
gate: ADOPT the opponent-specific player-distribution + Monte Carlo aggregation pattern iff the hierarchical gamma beats pooled baselines on 2025 held-out log-likelihood by >=3%; REJECT the paper's literal estimation procedure (moment + 5% tail rule, no pooling).

title: Efficient tracking of team sport players with few game-specific annotations
improvement: Stand up the few-annotation tracking pipeline: frozen appearance backbone + iterative tracklet association (paper's ~3.5-annotations/player saturation, +26pp IDF1 over ByteTrack) reproduced on the public rugby sevens data; port the annotation loop to American football broadcast (college/public NFL-analog), building the jersey-number OCR training set the paper flags as missing; add active learning (model-suggested highest-identity-entropy tracklets) and cross-game identity transfer so per-game annotation cost collapses to a season-scale labeling pipeline. Standing gates: legal review before NFL footage; never present semi-automatically labeled tracks as ground truth — report recall bounds.
gate: ACCEPT as ADAPT conditional on the public-data reproduction; demote to REJECT if it needs >10 annotations/player to beat ByteTrack.

title: Tournament schedules and incentives in a double round-robin tournament with four teams
improvement: Add stakeless-probability features to any group-stage/round-robin pricing: ex-ante p_stakeless_weak and p_stakeless_strong per game (paper's Poisson-simulation recipe with GSE's team strengths), interacted with rotation/news signals; fit separate conditional outcome models on historical dead rubbers; test whether markets already price stakelessness via closing-line comparisons; extend to a continuous 'incentive gradient' (prize-money/rank movement at stake).
gate: ADAPT iff stakeless status predicts outcomes: in GSE's historical group-stage data, weakly/strongly stakeless games show a statistically significant shift in goal/point distributions or favorite cover rates vs matched non-stakeless games; if dead rubbers are indistinguishable from live games, the feature adds nothing.

title: Social Media Sentiment Analysis for Cryptocurrency Market Prediction
improvement: Build the news-sentiment -> projection-error channel: collect 2024-season player/team sentiment from X + beat-writer RSS with a fixed lexicon (CNN channel included), compute per-entity daily metrics incl. the contradictive compound and a cross-channel disagreement metric (sentiment variance — disagreement, not level, as the mispricing predictor), test lagged correlation with next-week projection error at 1-7 day lags under nested walk-forward CV (refit quarterly), then lock the compound indicator and evaluate on 2025.
gate: ADAPT into the projection pipeline iff the locked 2025 evaluation shows |r| >= 0.10 with the correct sign and the indicator adds RMSE improvement in a bivariate blend; REJECT if out-of-sample |r| < 0.05 (signal was selection artifact).

title: Graph Neural Network based Agent in Google Research Football
improvement: Take only the graph-representation idea (discard the DQN/RL scaffolding): per-play player graphs from NGS tracking frames — 22 player nodes + ball node, node features = (x, y, speed, accel, orientation, team, down/distance context), distance-weighted or learned adjacency edges — GCN/GAT encoder -> play/drive outcome head (EPA, success prob) trained supervised on nflverse 2020-2025 joined to tracking; then upgrade to spatio-temporal GCN (snap-1s to +2s frames) and test whether learned edges recover football structure (OL-DL, WR-CB matchups) as interpretable pick-model features.
gate: ADAPT iff on the 2025 tracking holdout the supervised player-graph GCN beats the hand-feature GBM baseline by >=5% EPA-RMSE AND the attention/GAT edge weights correlate sensibly with football structure (nearest defenders/opponents weighted); REJECT the GNN-tracking direction if it fails.

title: Bayesian estimation of in-game home team win probability for college basketball
improvement: Build NFL live win probability with a time-decayed pre-game anchor: pre-game anchor = vig-free moneyline-implied win prob; in-game likelihood from (time remaining, score differential, possession, down/distance, timeouts); blend weight w(t) on the anchor decaying ~1 at kickoff to ~0 late (early-game cells regularized toward the anchor to kill MLE-style overreaction to a 14-0 Q1 lead); learn w(t, game state) by minimizing held-out Brier instead of asserting it; report reliability curves by game segment.
gate: ADOPT the time-decayed anchor + early-game regularization iff it beats market-implied WP on 2024-2025 held-out Brier AND shows calibration slope within [0.9, 1.1]; REJECT the paper's literal beta-prior cell machinery (basketball-specific) — implement the shrinkage principle inside GSE's existing WP model.

title: Faster Online Calibration Without Randomization: Interval Forecasts
improvement: Stand up POTC-Cal as a parallel online recalibration signal on GSE's sequential probability stream: 2-epsilon grid over [0,1] (epsilon=0.025), per-bin deficit/excess tracked as games resolve, weekly interval output collapsed to midpoint for downstream consumers while logging interval width as an uncertainty signal; run one POTC instance per market (spread, moneyline, total) with shared epsilon tuned jointly; test the paper's open two-choice extension (score the endpoint closest to the batch-recalibrated probability).
gate: Adopt POTC iff over the 6-season chronological backtest its end-of-season epsilon-CE (0.025) is <=0.5x the running-Platt baseline AND prediction SD stays >=0.8x the raw engine's SD (no sharpness collapse) AND Brier is no worse than raw + 0.002; reject (keep batch recalibration only) otherwise.

title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
improvement: Build 'ask the film a question': few-shot VQA over broadcast clips — K=4-8 labeled (clip, analyst note) pairs + query clip -> scheme label, coverage call, or injury-mechanism note; open VLM (frozen vision encoder + frozen small LM + trainable gated xattn-dense bridge, Perceiver Resampler to 64 tokens/clip), trained on an 'M3W-sports' corpus of clips interleaved with analyst notes/play-by-play — plus tracking-conditioned visual prompting: prepend discretized trajectory token streams so the LM cross-attends to both pixels and trajectories (broadcast pixels lose depth/occlusion; tracking preserves disguised coverages).
gate: ACCEPT iff Flamingo-style 4-shot prompting beats the fine-tuned video-classifier baseline by >=5 percentage points accuracy on held-out folds AND close-ended likelihood scores are rank-calibrated (top-1 correct >=60% when margin >0.3); REJECT if it fails to beat the fine-tuned specialist.

title: Nested Zero Inflated Generalized Poisson Regression for FIFA World Cup 2022
improvement: Build the nested + in-simulation-update playoff engine: per-game team points ~ Normal/NB with mean from nested regression — mu_A(offense A vs defense B, averaged both-ways), then mu_B|A conditional on realized points_A (garbage-time/defense-relaxation); covariates = GSE ratings instead of Elo points, home/neutral, rest differential; game weights w(m) = (1/2)^{days/H} x importance (playoffs 2-4x) with team-specific regime-aware decay (half-life shortens after coaching/QB changes, learned by backtest log-likelihood).
gate: ADOPT iff across postseasons 2020-2024: mean Brier beats GSE's current static-strength sim by >=5% AND beats/ties the futures-implied baseline on RPS in >=4 of 5 postseasons; REJECT if the in-simulation update adds nothing over the static sim.

title: How Much Does Home Field Advantage Matter in Soccer Games? A Causal Inference Approach for English Premier League Analysis
improvement: Build the division-pair HFA causal estimator: paired differences from division games only (home+away per season -> 6 paired differences per team-season, 2018-2025), model Y_{i,j,s} = alpha_{i,j,s} + beta_{i,s} + eps with beta ~ N(Delta_s, sigma^2_s), on team-game offensive/defensive EPA, success rate, penalties — attributing HFA to offense vs defense vs officiating; extend to time-varying venue effects with crowd size and travel-miles moderators (the 2020 zero-crowd season is the natural experiment) for crowd-adjusted team-specific HFA.
gate: Adopt iff on the 2020-2022 fit: (a) league offensive-EPA Delta-hat > 0 with p < 0.05, (b) unbiased variance sigma-hat^2 >= 0 (sanity), (c) the sign of offensive-EPA Delta-hat persists on the 2023-2024 holdout (p < 0.10); reject if Delta-hat is indistinguishable from the naive mean difference.

title: Planning with Diffusion for Flexible Behavior Synthesis
improvement: Build GSE-Diffuser: 1D-temporal-conv U-Net diffusion over fixed-length padded (200-slot) play-state sequences (down, distance, yardline, score diff, time, play-type one-hots, EPA), trained DDPM on nflverse 2006-2025 with padding masked; unconditional sampling -> full-game score distributions; live pricing via inpainting the played prefix (clamp denoised prefix to observed plays each reverse step); return-guidance toward tail scenarios for exotic-prop pricing — then test hierarchical diffusion (coarse drive-summary diffusion conditioning a fine play-level model via cross-attention) for variable-length games and faster sampling.
gate: ADOPT diffusion as a simulation backbone iff on 2024 held-out: final-score TVD <=5% per week AND WP ECE <=0.03 AND sampling throughput >=1k games/minute/GPU (warm-started, <=20 steps); REJECT if throughput falls below that (a beautiful simulator that can't Monte-Carlo in production is useless).

title: Athlete rating in multi-competitor games with scored outcomes via monotone transformations
improvement: Build the transformed DLM team-strength feature: nflverse 2009-2025 score differentials, learn monotone I-spline margin transform (3 knots at 25/50/75th percentiles) + parameters via MAP (L-BFGS) on 2009-2019 (report whether the transform shrinks |margin|>21 tails — itself evidence about NFL margin informativeness), Kalman filter for weekly theta_t with home-field/rest covariates, team-specific observation variances (sigma^2_u per team) via variational/EM M-step keeping closed-form Kalman updates.
gate: ADOPT iff on 2020-2024: log-loss beats the no-transform Kalman DLM by >=1% AND beats Elo by >=0.5%, with the learned transform visibly non-identity (shrinkage of |margin|>21 tails); REJECT if the transform collapses to ~identity (like the paper's rugby case) with no log-loss gain.

title: Selective Classification Via Neural Network Training Dynamics
improvement: Build GSE-NNTD: during training snapshot slate predictions at each boosting round/epoch/seed (25-50 snapshots); per pick compute late-weighted disagreement of snapshot predictions vs the final pick; add as a second gate feature alongside the learned score — abstain when disagreement is high even if final edge looks good ('changed its mind late' picks) — weighted by when flips happen relative to line movement (a late-training flip on a pick whose market line moved against it is doubly suspect).
gate: ADAPT accepted iff adding the disagreement feature improves AuRC by >=5% relative over the edge-only gate on walk-forward seasons AND the top-disagreement abstentions are enriched for losses (precision check); else REJECT the feature (keep snapshot logging off to save storage).

title: A Survey on Video Action Recognition in Sports (arXiv:2206.01038v1) — REPLACEMENT for 0620
improvement: Use the survey's method taxonomy as the build menu for GSE's experimental video lane: (1) reproduce a SlowFast/TSM baseline on public SoccerNet event classification in PyTorch (validation of the pipeline before NFL footage); (2) fine-tune to NFL play-type/event recognition (formation, play result, personnel); (3) add the pose stream (ST-GCN) for the injury-hazard direction; then train a single multi-task model (event classification + temporal localization + pose estimation) instead of the survey's single-task baselines — localization and pose are the same underlying signal as recognition on small NFL pilots.
gate: ADOPT the video lane's architecture menu iff the SoccerNet reproduction lands within 3 points of published accuracy AND a pilot fine-tune on ~200 labeled NFL plays achieves top-1 >= 0.70 on play-type classification; if the NFL pilot < 0.60, park the lane.

title: Projectile motion in a medium with quadratic drag at constant horizontal wind
improvement: Implement the closed-form wind-drag formulas (paper's eq. 10) in weather/wind_adjust.py: per kick, inputs = launch speed/angle (charting archetypes), football drag k = 1/V_term^2 (calibrate V_term ~28-30 m/s), stadium wind vector decomposed along kick direction; compute wind-perturbed vs no-wind range -> expected-distance delta in yards as a feature in the FG-make logistic and punt-distance models; runs in microseconds for live recomputation — then upgrade to a two-layer wind model (free-stream above bowl + per-stadium in-bowl shielding factor fit from punt residuals), turning each stadium into a proprietary wind-transfer-function asset.
gate: ADOPT iff the wind-adjusted model reduces RMSE by >= 1.5 yards vs the punter-mean baseline on the windy-game holdout AND the fitted V_term lands in a physically sane range (20-40 m/s).

title: Explainable expected goal models for performance analysis in football analytics
improvement: Build an 'AP what-if' layer over GSE's existing expected-metric models (no new training): for any player/team and feature (aDOT, target location, defensive front), compute aggregated profiles — fix the feature on a grid, average predictions over that player's actual targets this season; serve in an internal prop-research notebook and content graphics, with guardrails (profiles only on the original data distribution, shade outside observed support, bootstrap CIs) — then go beyond the paper with coverage-conditional profiles (aDOT split by man vs zone).
gate: ADOPT the AP what-if layer iff Test 1 fidelity holds for >= 16 of 20 players (AP value at observed mean aDOT matches actual yards-per-target within +-0.5) AND Test 2 shows AP beats the global PDP by >= 0.10 Spearman points on half-2 efficiency ranking; REJECT if median player curve correlation across halves < 0.7.

title: Towards Better Selective Classification
improvement: Train GSE's cover classifier with entropy-regularized loss L = CE + beta*H(p) (start beta=0.01, sweep {0.1,0.01,0.001,0.0001}); publish gate = rank games by max softmax probability, publish top-c_target fraction with the threshold calibrated on the prior season; monitor subgroup coverage so the filter doesn't systematically exclude divisional/bad-weather games; test the paper's central claim causally by freezing a SelectiveNet-style classifier and swapping only the selection mechanism (head vs SR vs entropy).
gate: ADAPT iff (a) entropy-regularized + SR beats vanilla + SR on test-window covered-set ROI by >=1pp at matched 30% coverage, or (b) vanilla + SR beats the 3-head learned selection head by >=1pp — either confirms the paper's ordering on sports data; reject if the learned head beats SR.

title: Performance Prediction in Major League Baseball by Long Short-Term Memory Networks
improvement: Build NFL season-total projection LSTMs: input = 5 prior seasons x ~20 features (age, games, attempts/targets, yards, TDs, EPA/play, team context, injuries), stacked LSTM (<=3 layers, <=128 cells) -> FC -> ReLU, MSE/Adam, expanding-window retraining; evaluate with the paper's full scorecard (MAE/RMSE, accuracy within +-k, per-tier correct counts, over/under asymmetry) — then build the deliberate two-model ensemble the paper implies but never builds: one conservative (MSE, the lower bound) + one aggressive (asymmetric loss penalizing underestimation) LSTM, using the interval for futures/award pricing.
gate: Accept iff the LSTM beats GSE's regression baseline on 2023-2024 holdouts by >=3% MAE on at least two of three yardage categories AND the elite-bias diagnostic reveals a correctable asymmetry; reject if it merely matches regression (the paper's own 2018 result: LR essentially tied the LSTMs).

title: What Makes Forest-Based Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimators Work?
improvement: Adopt the paper's CATE ingredient ranking as GSE's default causal recipe: for any binary treatment (short rest, turf, new play-caller) and outcome (EPA/play, win, injury): propensity forest + marginal-mean forest, then a model-based forest on E[Y|x,t] = m-hat(x) + tau(x)(t - pi-hat(x)) with simultaneous prognostic/predictive splits — minimum viable version = treatment-centering only (mob(W-hat)), which captured most of the gain under confounding; Poisson-forest likelihood for injury counts, interval-censored likelihood for games-missed with heaping.
gate: ADOPT the mob(W-hat) implementation iff the semi-synthetic short-rest test shows MSE(tau-hat) <= 1.2x the causal-forest MSE (parity) and >=2x improvement over uncentered mob; otherwise REJECT the custom implementation and use off-the-shelf grf causal forests. The ingredient ranking (treatment-centering mandatory, outcome-centering optional) is adopted as recipe immediately.

title: Rethinking Symbolic Regression Datasets and Benchmarks for Scientific Discovery
improvement: Harden GSE's symbolic-regression pipeline against the paper's vulnerability: adopt NED (normalized tree-edit distance to domain reference forms, e.g. logistic in EPA margin) as a structural evaluation alongside R^2; selection rule = among equations within 1% validation Brier of the best, prefer the lowest-NED (structural Occam's razor); acceptance test = inject 3 log-uniform dummy columns into the weekly team-stat matrix and audit what fraction of selected PySR equations include dummies — then extend the audit with correlated dummies (noisy copies of real features at 0.3/0.6/0.9 correlation) to map the exact failure boundary for pre-grouping correlated stat clusters.
gate: ADAPT iff the dummy audit finds >= 30% of currently selected equations include injected dummies (vulnerability is live) OR the mini user study replicates the paper (NED correlates with analyst plausibility ratings at |PCC| >= 0.3 while R^2 does not, p < 0.05); REJECT iff dummy-inclusion < 10% AND R^2/NED selection agree on > 90% of targets.

title: Developing a Ranking Problem Library (RPLIB) from a data-oriented perspective
improvement: Build a rankability module in the Sports repo: for any dominance matrix D-bar (pairwise team win counts; unit-advantage indicators), solve the LOP exactly (n=32, scipy.milp/OR-Tools), compute k (distance to nearest perfectly rankable matrix), |P| (optimal-solution count), tau (max Kendall-tau over the pool), and beta (fractional-entry-weighted positional indecision); apply to weekly NFL power-ranking instances (flag ambiguous top-8 weeks -> shrink edge estimates) and to GSE's model-comparison matrices (is 'model A > model B' even rankable?) — then make beta stake-weighted by betting handle/edge at each rank position, turning a descriptive diagnostic into a risk-management input for bet sizing.
gate: ADOPT beta as a diagnostic iff on 2015-2023, preseason beta explains >=10% additional variance (delta R^2 >= 0.10) in next-season Massey prediction error beyond k and |P| alone, with the same sign confirmed on 2024; REJECT if beta adds nothing over the three existing measures.

title: Doubly-online changepoint detection for monitoring health status during sports activities
improvement: Build a between-online changepoint monitor over weekly player series (EPA/play, snap share, NGS top speed/acceleration, target share): segment-specific latent trend + week-specific disturbance (game script, opponent), linear-Gaussian state space + online EM; alert when P(changepoint) > delta -> prop-model flag + feature freeze until the new segment has >=3 weeks (delta tuned for high sensitivity — missing an injury is worse than a false flag); second use = team-level regime detection on offensive EPA/play to trigger model refits; then make the changepoint prior covariate-dependent lambda(X) (injury history, age, snap load, days rest) and allow game-script covariates to modulate week-specific states.
gate: Accept iff it beats CUSUM on F1 against injury/role-change ground truth on 2019-2023 AND the within-+-1-week precision justifies the alert volume (<=2 flags per team-week on average); REJECT if the changepoint rate approaches the paper's 40% (pure noise) or EM fails to converge on 17-game series — fall back to BOCPD.

title: Ranking with multiple types of pairwise comparisons
improvement: Build the multimodal team-strength EM: per-drive team-facet matchup outcomes (rushing EPA>0 winner, dropback EPA>0 winner, turnover winner, special-teams winner, penalty-yardage winner — each logistic-residualized on pre-drive score differential to kill the game-script confound), MAP-EM with logistic prior per season + rolling 8-week windows; outputs = team strengths s_u (a new power rating) + valence vector q_t (which facets carry most strength information — itself publishable); blend s_u into the engine as an additional strength prior — then make valence time-varying and matchup-dependent (hierarchical q_{t,week}) with an offense/defense split (separate lambda^O_u, lambda^D_u).
gate: ADOPT as an engine input iff across 2016-2023: (a) log-loss on game winners >=2% better than unimodal Bradley-Terry, OR (b) ATS hit rate beats the EPA-ranking baseline by >=1.5 points with the same sign in >=6 of 8 seasons; REJECT if neither holds or q_t signs flip on >2 of 5 facets year-to-year.

title: ENS-10: A Dataset For Post-Processing Ensemble Weather Forecasts
improvement: Adopt the EECRPS-style metric: score all GSE weather-edge models with extreme-weighted CRPS on the NFL stadium dataset (high-wind, heavy-precip, cold games) — extreme games are where weather edges pay; train the baseline ladder (MLP -> LeNet -> per-pixel transformer) on GEFS/HRRR ensemble reforecasts over 30 stadium neighborhoods as the cheap warm-start before the flow model; don't download 3TB — implement on GEFS reforecast for stadium neighborhoods only — then train the baselines with an EECRPS-weighted loss and test whether extreme-optimized models beat CRPS-optimized ones on heavy-precip/high-wind kickoff games without losing average CRPS.
gate: ADOPT iff any NN baseline cuts CRPS >= 10% vs raw on wind speed AND the EECRPS ranking matches the CRPS ranking (extreme skill not traded away); REJECT if Gaussian-CRPS post-processing can't beat raw on wind speed — then go straight to the flow/LGBM recipes and this paper stays a metric citation.

title: Benchmark Dataset for Precipitation Forecasting by Post-Processing the Numerical Weather Prediction
improvement: Build the stadium-weather post-processor for game-day features (kickoff wind speed/direction, precipitation probability, temperature): pull NWS/NWP gridded forecasts (GFS/NAM) for stadium coordinates, supervise with METAR station observations (the AWS analogue), train gradient boosting on the curated feature set (graduate to U-Net/ConvLSTM only if justified), split-by-forecast-origin discipline, CSI/Bias categorical verification; feed calibrated weather distributions into the totals model — then fix the paper's open heavy-tail failure with a two-head model: occurrence classifier + generalized-Pareto/quantile-regression extreme-value tail head, blended by predicted intensity.
gate: ADAPT iff the post-processor improves on raw NWP (CSI +>=0.02 on precipitation occurrence, wind-speed MAE - >=5%) on the held-out window AND the calibrated weather features improve the totals model's log-loss/Brier vs raw-weather inputs; REJECT if post-processing adds no skill over raw NWP at stadium scale.

title: Predicting Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury in Rookie Major League Baseball Pitchers
improvement: Port the rookie-injury predictor to NFL: rookie injury-risk (hamstring/ACL) from college workload + combine + rookie preseason features (the football analogue of 'rookie-season stats -> career injury'); protocol fixes = published feature list, year-based splits with stated cutoffs, PR-AUC + calibration alongside ROC-AUC, workload-only baseline; start with the paper's MLP winner + XGBoost — then replace binary classification with a survival model (time-to-first-injury, Cox/DeepHit-style), since the paper throws away when the injury happened and workload->injury is inherently temporal.
gate: Adopt iff the NFL port achieves ROC-AUC >= 0.65 with 95% CIs excluding 0.5 on the 2022-2024 forward test AND beats the workload-only baseline (the paper's 0.674 is the meet-or-beat benchmark).

title: Bayesian estimation of in-game home team win probability for NBA games
improvement: Upgrade GSE's live-WP blending with the paper's mechanism: gse.live.WPBlender — per (seconds elapsed, score differential, down/distance bucket) cells, empirical WP with a dynamic beta prior whose alpha,beta come from GSE's pregame model mapped through a prior-strength schedule (high early, decaying); posterior mean (n+alpha)/(N+alpha+beta); logistic blend of pregame and cell WP with features {t, |l|, l^2, I(l=0), possession}, coefficients fit by minimizing Brier on a validation slice strictly before the test slice (fixing the paper's leakage); serve per-second with cell-sample-size diagnostics.
gate: ADAPT (keep the blend) iff on the strictly held-out 2022-2024 test the blended estimator beats GSE's current live-WP Brier by >= 0.002 AND beats the no-blend cell estimator by >= 0.003, with calibration slope in [0.95, 1.05]; miss -> REJECT the blend (keep the beta-prior cell estimator only if it alone beats baseline).

title: Globally Combining Forecasts (Eckert, Hyndman & Panagiotelis, 2023)
improvement: Add CV-tuned soft-global forecast combination: combine GSE's sub-model forecasts per week with weights tuned by cross-validation that blend global (pooled across games) and local (game-specific) combination weights — comparing CV-tuned soft-global weights against local-only, hard-global, and equal-weight baselines on out-of-sample MSFE/log score, with 2020 as the disruption negative control (global pooling should degrade) and 2022 as the stable-season positive control.
gate: No numeric gate specified in the ledger; compare out-of-sample MSFE/log score for CV-tuned soft-global weights against local, hard-global, and equal-weight baselines, with 2020 as the disruption negative control and 2022 as the stable-season positive control.

title: GOAL: Towards Benchmarking Few-Shot Sports Game Summarization
improvement: Use GOAL (first English sports-summarization dataset) as the English transfer validation bed: port the select->rewrite->fluency-MMR-rerank pipeline and the KES knowledge-fusion recipe to GOAL's English soccer data — they must beat LED's ROUGE-L 24.3 on the GOAL test set before any NFL application; replicate the semi-supervised self-training setup on the 2,160 unlabeled docs (analog of training on unlabeled NFL text streams with a small hand-labeled set); use the key-verb probing idea as a diagnostic for sports-domain familiarity in GSE content models.
gate: ACCEPTED (ADAPT): first and only English sports-summarization dataset + four benchmark settings defined + public release; as a benchmark and transfer testbed it is solid ADAPT material. NFL-port gate: adapted pipeline beats LED's 24.3 ROUGE-L on the GOAL test set.

title: On the Efficacy of the Wisdom of Crowds to Forecast Economic Indicators
improvement: Change GSE's consensus computation: wherever multiple probability estimates are blended (model outputs, cross-book market-implied probabilities, pundit panels), compute both mean and median and default the published edge to the median-based blend; add a 'consensus disagreement' diagnostic |mean - median| as an outlier-sensitivity flag (>3pp of probability -> surface the dissenting source for analyst review); track a 'beat-all' statistic per model (fraction of weeks each constituent beats the median consensus in log-loss) as a model-health monitor — then test trimmed/winsorized means (5/10/20%) against pure median and mean.
gate: ADAPT accepted iff median consensus achieves log-loss no worse than mean consensus (within 0.5%) AND beats all constituent models in >=2% of games (matching the paper's 0.026 for median); reject if median log-loss is >1% worse than mean.

title: Time Series Prediction under Distribution Shift using Differentiable Forgetting
improvement: Deploy learned forgetting weights in the engine's training: per offseason (and Week 9 checkpoint), fit differentiable forgetting curves alpha(tau;eta) = exp(-eta1*tau) and the mixed form on the game-level rows via the paper's bi-level gradient routine (logistic surrogate), then train the season's engine with each historical game weighted by alpha(age;eta-hat) as sample weights into LightGBM (two-stage); refit eta per era segment around major rule changes — then go beyond the paper with feature-group-specific forgetting curves: fast decay for personnel-dependent features (QB EPA, pressure rate), medium for scheme features, near-zero for structural features (HFA, altitude), with an L2 pull toward the global curve to preserve effective sample size.
gate: Adopt learned forgetting weights iff the GradMixedDecay-weighted model beats BOTH baselines (stationary unweighted and 3-season window) by >= 0.003 log-loss on the held-out 2025 season AND the learned decay curve is non-degenerate (effective sample size >= 300 games); reject if it fails to beat the fixed window baseline. Mid-season refit only if the offseason fit clears the gate.

title: Sparse Bayesian State-Space and Time-Varying Parameter Models
improvement: Build sparse-TVP team ratings: non-centered TVP regression of margin on team dummies + situational features (nflverse 2015-2025 weekly), triple-gamma or horseshoe prior on sqrt(theta_j) (prototype in shrinkTVP, port to Stan/PyMC), read off P(dynamic) per team — dynamic teams get time-varying ratings, others static; refit weekly with warm-started MCMC/Laplace — then add a Markov-switching (break) component to the state equation for coaching/QB-change weeks so P(dynamic) concentrates on true regime changes rather than smooth drift.
gate: ADOPT iff rolling 2022-2024 RMSE beats the Elo baseline by >=3% AND the posterior classifies at least 20% of team coefficients as dynamic (the model actually uses its flexibility); reject if classification collapses to all-fixed or MCMC makes weekly refits unreliable.

title: GCN-WP: Semi-Supervised Graph Convolutional Networks for Win Prediction in Esports
improvement: Build the calibrated GCN-WP: NFL team-game graph (nodes = 32 teams x 17 games, edges = previous-game + opponent-game per Algorithm 1), delta features (offensive/defensive EPA, success rate, explosive-play differentials), logistic output head for calibrated win probabilities trained semi-supervised on 2015-2024, evaluated on log-loss/Brier vs the engine's current model and Elo (the paper's missing experiment) — then implement the authors' stated future work properly: directed edges (past->present only, killing leakage structurally), typed edges (self-temporal vs opponent vs divisional), per-edge-type attention, testing whether the directed-heterogeneous 2-3 layer GCN beats the 1-layer homogeneous version.
gate: Adopt as a ratings/ensemble arm iff the calibrated GCN beats the engine's current win-probability model on 2023-2024 Brier by >=0.003 with acceptable calibration (ECE within 0.005 of baseline); reject if it merely matches Elo — keep the BuildLeagueGraph construction as a feature-engineering recipe only.

title: Detecting Concept Drift in the Presence of Sparsity — A Case Study of Automated Change Risk Assessment
improvement: Stand up the drift-monitor ensemble in the Tuesday cron: three detectors in parallel on the weekly resolved-game stream — ECDD on the error stream, PUDD on the PU-index stream, Page-Hinkley on the Brier stream — majority rule: drift declared if >=2 of 3 fire within a 3-week window (NFL-scaled analog of the paper's 1000-2000-instance window); sparse weekly features imputed first per the paper's recipe (sparsity audit, runs test, Q-Q check, kNN-vs-baseline bake-off); score the monitor itself with TPD/drift-count/ADD in weeks against labeled regime episodes — then test reliability-weighted voting (weights from trailing-season TPD precision, updated annually).
gate: ADOPT the majority-vote ensemble as the production drift policy iff on 2020-2025 nflverse: (i) ensemble TPD in [0.8, 1.2] per labeled regime episode, (ii) <=2 false alarms/season, (iii) ensemble ADD <= best single detector's ADD + 1 week; REJECT the ensemble (keep the best single detector) if (iii) fails. Adopt the imputation recipe independently iff >=10% RMSE improvement over median imputation on masked weeks.

title: Bayesian estimation of in-game home team win probability for Division-I FBS college football
improvement: Build GSE live win-probability v1: (1) NFL team pace estimates from nflverse (opponent-adjusted, Pomeroy-style recursion); (2) XGBoost expected-points model for current+next drive from down/distance/field position/time; (3) Bayesian estimator on (tau, omega) cells from 2015-2024 play-by-play with beta prior from GSE's pregame model; blend pregame prob with linear-in-time-and-score weight fit on 2022-2023 holdout Brier — then replace the expert-imputed beta prior with an empirical-Bayes prior from GSE pregame probabilities binned by cell, and add down/distance/timeout state to the cell definition.
gate: Ship live WP v1 iff 2023-2024 holdout Brier beats nflfastR wp on >=60% of games and calibration slope in [0.9, 1.1]; hold as research prototype otherwise.

title: 1336 Another look at forecast trimming for combinations: robustness, accuracy and diversity
improvement: Stand up RAD (robustness-accuracy-diversity) trimming for the model pool: per season/week, trailing-4-week validation window, per-model MSE-equivalent + pairwise MSEC on point forecasts, Tukey's-fences screen on per-model absolute-error variance, backward ADT elimination (kappa=1, delta=0.05) to the stop rule, combine survivors with simple average; add the RelDiv dashboard rule (RelDiv = AvgMSEC/AvgMSE; <0.2 -> skip diversity handling; >0.5 -> full RAD; 0.2-0.5 -> accuracy-only) — validating any trimming on BOTH point and interval scores (MSIS), never point scores alone — then derive a scoring-rule ADT analog (ADT_log with mean pairwise KL/CRPS divergence) for distributional combination under logarithmic pooling.
gate: ADAPT the RelDiv-conditional trimming protocol iff the reproducible test replicates the paper's core ordering (RAD >= A > None on point scores, no interval degradation) on 2024 data; REJECT diversity-only trimming (D) outright — the paper's MCB results void it; if RelDiv stays <0.2 for GSE's pools, downgrade to accuracy-only screening per the paper's own guideline.

title: Online Sparse Streaming Feature Selection with Uncertainty (OS2FSU)
improvement: Build the OS2FSU sparse-feature selector for the weekly pipeline: Phase I — buffer each week's new/sparse features (Bs=8 weeks), LFA via SGD (rank 8) to impute missing team-game entries; Phase II — Fisher's-z relevance on imputed features vs cover label, fuzzy band mu in [0.01,0.1] via trapezoidal MF, neighborhood-rough-set dependency gamma for fuzzy-band features; selected sparse features feed the feature gate carrying an 'imputed' flag so downstream can down-weight — then make the fuzzy band missingness-adaptive: scale the band by per-feature imputation confidence (LFA reconstruction error on held-out observed entries), which doubles as data-quality monitoring for the weekly pipeline.
gate: Accept iff OS2FSU (LFA-impute + fuzzy select) beats both drop-masked and mean-fill+standard-selection arms on 2024 log-loss by >= 0.002 AND retains >= 5 of the 10 masked features; reject if it <= mean-fill, selections are unstable across seeds, or theta > 0.6 missingness on any real feature (drop the feature instead).

title: Conformal Risk Control
improvement: Stand up conformal risk control on the posted-card workflow: C_lambda = {games with |edge| >= lambda}, loss = fraction of posted picks that lose (bounded, monotone in lambda); on a rolling calibration window of past posted picks choose lambda-hat per the CRC rule at alpha = 0.45 (control expected loss-rate below 45%, i.e. win-rate above 55%) and post only C_{lambda-hat}; same machinery for slate drawdown control (loss = max drawdown of the week's posted slate); use the covariate-shift extension with a regime indicator (QB-change weeks) — then test conditional (Mondrian) risk control within strata (favorites/dogs, high/low totals) with stratum-specific alpha_b, since GSE's failure modes are stratum-specific (e.g., primetime dogs).
gate: ADOPT iff the rolling backtest shows mean realized loss-rate <= alpha - 0.01 (tight, like the paper's 0.0987 vs 0.1) at acceptable volume (>=60% of unfiltered); REJECT the drawdown variant if the (B-alpha)/n correction collapses volume below 30% of baseline.

title: SDWPF: A Dataset for Spatial Dynamic Wind Power Forecasting
improvement: Use SDWPF as the benchmark substrate for GSE's wind-forecasting lane: reproduce the Autoformer/Informer baselines on the public 48-hour task (RMSE ~= 47.1, MAE ~= 37.6 verification), verify a graph-wavenet variant beats the transformer baselines before committing it to the stadium-wind network (turbines -> stadium locations, power -> wind speed/gusts, retrained on public mesonet data); adopt the paper's data-caveat checklist (missing values, status flags, abnormal readings) as the QA spec for any real wind-data pipeline — then shorten the horizon to 6-24 hours (game-day relevant) and re-benchmark with turbine-to-turbine attention learned from data vs fixed geographic adjacency.
gate: ADAPT: the benchmark data and task definition are exactly what GSE needs to stand up a credible wind-forecasting lane — value as substrate, not just method.

title: Gradient-Based Meta-Learning Using Uncertainty to Weigh Loss for Few-Shot Learning
improvement: Build uncertainty-weighted meta-learning for new-regime team-seasons: task pool = team-seasons 2015-2025 (support = first K games, query = next games), small tabular MLP on game features -> margin, checkpoint initialization pool (score each checkpoint on the K observed games, pick argmin-loss), meta-loss Sum_i(L_i/sigma_i^2 + log sigma_i) with learned per-season sigma_i (expect 2020 COVID and injury-decimated seasons to learn large sigma) — then go heteroscedastic: replace scalar sigma_i with input-dependent sigma_i(x) from game context (weather, injuries, rivalry), marrying the paper's uncertainty weighting to game-conditional noise.
gate: ADOPT iff the homoscedastic variant beats vanilla MAML by >=0.02 Brier on new-regime win prediction at K in {2,4} (2023-2025) AND shows the paper's robustness (loss spread across alpha values <= half of MAML's spread); reject if init-selection picks checkpoints no better than the global init at K=4.

title: Using Conformal Win Probability to Predict the Winners of the Cancelled 2020 NCAA Basketball Tournaments
improvement: Build the CPD win-probability head: fit y_uvw = mu_w + theta_uw - theta_vw + epsilon on rolling trailing windows via OLS with team strengths re-fit weekly; for each upcoming game build pi(y_c, 1/2) over a grid of candidate MOV values using signed residuals; moneyline prob = 1 - pi(0, 1/2), spread-cover prob at line s = pi(-s, 1/2); serve per-game evaluation as table lookup + interpolation on the precomputed residual CDF; reuse the Eq. 3 recursion for fixed-bracket contest pricing — then go beyond the paper with time-decayed weighted least squares (recency weighting) and locally-weighted conformity scores, tested on weeks 12-18 where late-season form shifts matter most.
gate: ADOPT into the engine iff on 2021-2024 walk-forward its log-loss is >=1% better than the logistic baseline AND its low-probability calibration (predicted 0.05-0.35 bucket) has |observed - predicted| <= 0.03 in every bucket; otherwise reject and keep logistic.

title: Group Activity Recognition in Basketball Tracking Data -- Neural Embeddings in Team Sports (NETS)
improvement: Build the tracking-concept recognition pipeline: weak-label rule engine first — programmatic detectors for NFL group concepts (play-action via run-fake geometry + QB dropback depth vs handoff; screen via OL release + RB lateral drift; blitz via defender crossing LOS within X frames of snap; RPO mesh; coverage shell rotation), each validated against a few hundred manually watched plays (target >=80% specificity); per-player LSTM trajectory embedders + role one-hots -> Transformer encoder (d_h=256, 6-8 layers) -> team-wise sum pooling -> classification head; training recipe = self-supervised next-H-frame prediction -> weak-label fine-tune -> small manual-label fine-tune; export play embeddings as engine features — then upgrade to a play-phase-aware hierarchical model (0.5s micro-window encoder for pre-snap/mesh/stem/break feeding a play-level Transformer with learned phase attention).
gate: ADAPT/ADOPT iff on the 2024-season manual test set: (a) the sequential recipe (pretrain->weak->manual) beats the weak-label rules' macro F1 by >=3 points, AND (b) absolute macro F1 >= 0.80; REJECT if the recipe fails to beat the hand-written rules (rules alone are then the cheaper solution), or weak-rule specificity can't reach 80% after two revision rounds.

title: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models
improvement: Build GSE-IRIS: tokenize each play as a discrete multi-token tuple (play_type, formation_family, direction, rusher/receiver bucket, yardage bucket, EPA bucket, score_event, turnover flag) — a play-level 'language' of ~2-5k vocabulary; train a GPT-style transformer (causal LM) on nflverse play sequences 2006-2025 with next-token CE + per-play score/termination heads, conditioned on a pregame matchup embedding as context tokens; sample 100k games per matchup in parallel for score distributions — then add hierarchical tokens: a drive-level summary token every drive (result, points, plays, starting field position) with an auxiliary drive-outcome head for explicit long-range structure and better 4th-quarter tail calibration.
gate: ADOPT the token-autoregressive architecture as GSE's primary game simulator iff on 2024 held-out: one-step-ahead log-likelihood >=5% better than the RSSM variant AND final-score TVD <=5% per week AND WP ECE <=0.03; REJECT if it underperforms the RSSM on two of three metrics (transformers are data-hungry and NFL has only ~500k plays). Either way, the losing backbone is dropped.

title: Regime-Dependent Factor Graphical LASSO for Forecast Combination (Lee & Seregina, 2023)
improvement: Build the regime-dependent factor Graphical LASSO combiner for GSE's correlated model zoo: panel of weekly forecast errors from K~10-30 models over 3+ seasons; strip common errors via PCA, fit Graphical LASSO to the residual precision, compute Bates-Granger weights; run Bai-Perron break tests on the loadings and residual-precision sequence around known regime events (mid-season QB changes, COVID seasons) to drive regime-specific combination weights (discrete-kernel regime-dependent loadings + time-varying GL) instead of constant weights.
gate: Gate is the break-alignment/post-break MSFE test: detected Bai-Perron break dates must align with the known regime events, and post-break combined MSFE/log-score must beat both equal weights and sample-precision weights (the paper's RD-FGL beat EW by 30-70% MSFE where structure/breaks exist is the reference magnitude) — with a stable-period negative control (no spurious breaks; FGL no worse than EW in stable periods).

title: Quantitative probing: Validating causal models using quantitative domain knowledge
improvement: Stand up the quantitative-probe release gate for causal graphs: a versioned YAML probe suite (~25 quantitative probes over team-week indicators, e.g. ATE(pressure rate +10pp -> defensive EPA/play) negative with |effect| > 0.05 EPA/play; ATE(turnover margin +1 -> win prob) in [0.08, 0.25]; ATE(rest days -> offensive EPA) ~= 0 as a null probe that must NOT be 'discovered'); after each quarterly causal-graph refresh, identify probe estimands from the graph, estimate via the same outcome machinery, compute hit rate — publish graph-derived features/content only if hit rate >= 0.8 AND all null probes hold — then move to adaptive probe selection (rank probes by how much their estimates move under simulated graph perturbations) and use probe-failure clusters to localize graph errors (offense vs defense subgraph).
gate: ADOPT the probe suite as a release gate iff: (a) probe hit rate correlates with downstream Brier improvement across season blocks (Spearman rho <= -0.5), (b) the flipped-knowledge adversarial test drops hit rate below 0.5 (probes actually discriminate), (c) null probes hold at >=90% (no phantom causal claims); reject if hit rate is uncorrelated with downstream performance (|rho| < 0.3) — then probes are theater.

title: Prediction of the outcome of a Twenty-20 Cricket Match: A Machine Learning Approach
improvement: Build pairwise matchup ratings for NFL (WR-CB, QB-pass-rush): model matchup outcomes (yards per route run above expected) as s_ij = A + a_i - b_j with recency weights w = (1 + t - t_min)/(1 + t_max - t_min) and neighborhood regularization lambda*Sum(r_i - n_i)^2 (lambda ~= 0.7 start), fit by SGD, expanding weekly recompute; use as features in prop/spread models where individual matchups matter — then go Bayesian (TrueSkill/Glicko-2 style uncertainty so ratings carry confidence intervals into sizing), condition the intercept on game-script covariates (spread, total, dome/outdoor), and tune exponential-decay half-life by CV instead of the paper's linear recency weight.
gate: Accept iff on a strictly time-ordered backtest, models using the matchup ratings beat raw-aggregate features by >=1% MAE on player-prop-relevant targets AND the ratings show face-valid correlation with known elite matchups; reject if they don't beat simple expanding-window player averages or SGD fails to converge stably on thin 17-game data.

title: FRANS: Automatic Feature Extraction for Time Series Forecasting
improvement: Adopt FRANS-style CNN embeddings: per-team per-season game sequences (nflverse 2009-2026: EPA/play, success rate, pressure rate, turnover margin) through a multi-channel 1D-CNN (Fawaz-style + feature layer, dim 24) on a surrogate team-season classification task (windows cut strictly before the prediction week — leakage-safe); per-window features -> mean/medoid -> static team-season embedding fed into the engine's meta-learner combining sub-model outputs — then build the two-tower extension the authors propose: static tower (FRANS identity — 'who are they this year') + dynamic tower (windowed autoencoder of the last 4 games — 'how are they playing now'), since the identity x momentum interaction is where matchup-specific edges live.
gate: Adopt FRANS embeddings iff the meta-learner with FRANS features beats the handcrafted-feature meta-learner by >= 0.004 log-loss on 2024-2025 walk-forward AND the leakage audit passes (zero windows crossing the prediction boundary) AND per-team-season embedding stability holds (within-season cosine distance < 0.5x between-season distance); reject if the win is sub-noise or embeddings collapse.

title: Introducing Grid WAR: Rethinking WAR for Starting Pitchers
improvement: Adopt the convexity design rule as a standing GSE metric principle: any metric mapping performance -> wins/value must be computed per game and summed, never from season averages, when the mapping is convex (win probability in points allowed/scored is convex — allowing 40 vs 30 differs less than 20 vs 10); build an NFL context-neutral per-game QB WPA grid (team points per drive as Poisson(lambda), f(drives_remaining, point_differential), Empirical Bayes shrinkage for <1-season samples) — then make the grid opponent-adjusted (NFL has 17 games; opponent heterogeneity dominates) and test whether volatile QBs are systematically mispriced in DFS salaries (median-projection pricing undervalues variance) as a GPP leverage angle.
gate: Accept the design rule iff Test 1 replicates on NFL QB data (per-game-aggregated value regressed on average-converted value gives slope significantly < 1); accept the Empirical Bayes talent estimator iff it beats raw per-game means on 2024 rank RMSE; reject the Poisson drive grid iff it disagrees with the empirical WP grid by >2pp in any (drives, differential) cell (fall back to the empirical grid with monotonic smoothing).

title: Price Formation in Field Prediction Markets: the Wisdom in the Crowd
improvement: Build the informed-flow detector on line moves (paper's eq. 2): regress each market participant segment's price impact (line move caused) on (current line - line they last bet into); segments with significantly negative beta are informed flow — their subsequent moves get up-weighted in GSE's market-implied features, others down-weighted as noise; at book level where account data is unavailable: only apply per-book after detecting informed segments; never assume a sharp NFL flow is sharp in NBA (estimate informedness per league x market, re-estimate after regime breaks).
gate: For GSE the gate is a statistically positive DeltaAUC from line moves (pre->post) stratified by move size — the paper's +0.037-0.041 DeltaAUC on PS (informed) flow with 95% CI above zero (vs -0.003 to -0.012 for non-PS) is the reference magnitude for 'informed', and 2-3/4+ PS-trader markets beating 0/1 at p < 0.001 is the cross-sectional bar.

title: Price Formation in Field Prediction Markets: the Wisdom in the Crowd
improvement: Run the informed-flow detector in rolling windows and close the paper's untested loop: test whether the detected informed-flow share predicts the market-efficiency alpha metric — i.e., does the market become efficient (alpha -> negative) exactly when informed flow dominates? Implement as a rolling validation layer over record 141's detector: per window, compute informed-flow share (2-3/4+ PS-trader market equivalents) and the subsequent window's alpha (mean(W/p) - 1), and test the predicted negative relationship.
gate: Gate is the same market-microstructure validation: rolling informed-flow-share windows must predict the alpha efficiency metric with the predicted sign at statistical significance — if the informed-flow share does not predict efficiency, the detector is descriptive only, not predictive.

title: Observation Centric and Central Distance Recovery on Sports Player Tracking
improvement: Reproduce the SportsMOT tracking pipeline with open components (YOLOX-X + OC-SORT + OSNet) with validation-tuned thresholds (fixing the paper's test-tuning): adapt the football post-processing to NFL broadcast (re-derive time-gap/location-gating bins for 25-30 fps, shot-change detection as hard tracklet-termination, jersey-number OCR fused with the OSNet embedding in the association cost + team-classification head restricting the candidate queue to same-team tracklets), add field registration (homography) so image-plane tracklets map to field coordinates. Standing gates: legal review before any NFL footage; never present image-plane tracklets as field-coordinate tracking until registration is validated.
gate: ACCEPT as ADAPT conditional on the SportsMOT reproduction (staged HOTA gains OC-SORT < +central-distance < +post-processing on validation, final HOTA within ~3 points of 73.968) AND the NFL-broadcast acceptance test (IDF1 >= 70 on 10+ clips with shot changes); demote to REJECT if reproduction can't reach HOTA ~70 with honest tuning (competition overfit).

title: Bayesian Neural Network Versus Ex-Post Calibration For Prediction Uncertainty
improvement: Horse-race a small VI-BNN head (2 hidden layers, mean-field Gaussian, Pyro/PyMC) on GSE's tabular game features for win probability against the current NN + Platt/isotonic/beta-calibration pipeline on rolling time-ordered backtests (train <=2023, calibrate 2024-H1, test 2024-H2/2025), metric = log-loss + Brier + reliability diagrams — then test the stacking the paper never tries: beta/isotonic calibration of the VI-BNN's own predictive mean (intrinsic uncertainty + empirical recalibration).
gate: ADOPT the BNN head only iff it beats the best ex-post calibrator with statistical significance on time-ordered GSE data (paired Diebold-Mariano-style test at 5% — the paper's own standard, which the paper itself did not meet); otherwise REJECT and keep the cheaper post-hoc calibration stack ('calibration is usually enough').

title: TabDDPM: Modelling Tabular Data with Diffusion Models
improvement: Build the TabDDPM synthetic-season pipeline: nflverse team-game rows 2015-2025 (~3,000 rows; EPA/play and success-rate differentials, explosive-play rate, pressure rates, pace, rest, dome/outdoor, wind/temp bins, closing spread/total + season/week conditioning labels), Gaussian quantile transform + one-hot categoricals, class-conditional diffusion (timesteps 100, 4-6 layers x 256-512); offline batch generator producing 3-5 synthetic seasons per real season, mixed real+synthetic at a tuned ratio for spread/total/prop model training — then condition on market regime instead of raw season label: synthesize 'what would 2018-2022-style games look like under 2024 conditions' via a learned season embedding capturing rule/coaching/meta shifts.
gate: ADOPT iff BOTH: (a) real+synthetic beats real-only by >=0.003 log-loss on the held-out 2024 real season, AND (b) fidelity: per-feature TVD between synthetic and real marginals <=5% on >=90% of features (none exceeding 10%); REJECT if log-loss delta <0.003, any fidelity breach, or synthetic-only ML efficiency <95% of real-only. Evaluate over 3 generator seeds.

title: STaSy: Score-based Tabular data Synthesis
improvement: Wrap the tabular diffusion with the STaSy training strategy: TabRep roots-of-unity encodings for team/opponent/venue/weather/rest categoricals + quantile transforms for numerics, continuous score-based SDE (VP/VE/sub-VP per Table 7), self-paced learning (SPL alpha0=0.2, beta0=0.9, S=10,000) then probability-flow-ODE log-probability scoring with DSM fine-tuning on rows with log p(x_i) < tau (median threshold); select on CatBoost ML-efficiency on a held-out season + rare-regime coverage (playoff, extreme weather) — then initialize SPL record weights with a domain difficulty prior (down-weight known high-variance games) instead of uniform, to test whether the curriculum does real work on NFL structure rather than fitting noise.
gate: ADOPT the SPL + fine-tuning wrapper iff: (a) real+synthetic log-loss beats the naive VP-SDE baseline by >=0.003 on held-out 2024, (b) rare-regime coverage improves >=10% relative with no column-fidelity regression (Omega_col within 0.02 of baseline), (c) median 2024 log-probability under STaSy exceeds the naive model (the paper's fine-tuning signature 131.734 vs 129.293); REJECT if SPL collapses to near-uniform weights (curriculum does nothing — check the weight histogram).

title: Betting the system: Using lineups to predict football scores
improvement: Adopt the paper's 4-part scorecard as GSE's standard model-evaluation template: (1) fitness (MAE/RMSE/log-loss/Brier); (2) season-table reconstruction rank correlation (predicted vs actual win totals / playoff seeding); (3) tier accuracy (playoff teams, division winners); (4) flat-stake betting sim at recorded closing odds (ROI + CLV) — then extend it: replace flat stakes with Kelly-sized stakes from the model's own calibrated probabilities (a fifth CLV component), and run the granularity bake-off by position group (key-position-only lineup model vs full-lineup vs pure-aggregate), since NFL QB vs WR inactives have asymmetric value.
gate: Adopt the scorecard as GSE's standard iff it surfaces at least one model-ranking disagreement between fitness metrics and the betting/tier components on GSE's own backtests (must add information beyond MAE/RMSE); adopt the granularity prior iff lineup-level features fail to beat aggregates by >2% MAE on 2024 totals; reject the granularity claim for NFL if lineup features do help (the soccer result need not hold for football).

title: Risk-Sensitive Markov Decision Processes with Long-Run CVaR Criterion
improvement: Stand up the seasonal risk-sensitive staking MDP: states = bankroll decile (10) x edge-availability bucket (high/low) = 20 states, actions = stake tiers {0, 0.5u, 1u, 1.5u, 2u} (0 = sit out the week), transitions from 2022-2025 weekly P&L, reward = weekly profit; policy iteration (difference-formula, 5 random restarts keeping best local optimum) on objective = CVaR_0.75(weekly cost) + beta*mean with beta in {0.1, 0.22, 0.4} as three policy tables (conservative/balanced/aggressive); regime gating (normal uses this table; loss frame switches to the randomized policy); monthly re-solve — then test a distributional evaluation (full long-run cost distribution per state-action) against a spectral risk measure instead of pure CVaR, checking the 'CVaR-blindness-to-success' failure mode.
gate: ACCEPT iff 2024-2025 simulation: long-run CVaR_0.75(weekly cost) <= 0.7x best baseline's AND mean weekly profit >= 0.9x best baseline's AND max drawdown <= 0.85x best baseline's; REJECT if the local-optimum spread across restarts exceeds 30% of the objective (landscape too unstable) or any beta setting underperforms flat-1u on all three metrics.

title: Efficient variational approximations for state space models
improvement: Port Efficient-VB as the production inference engine for GSE's dynamic state-space ratings: dynamic bivariate-Poisson team-strength model (attack/defense random walks, Poisson score likelihood) on nflverse 2000-2024 — train 2000-2019, test 2020-2024 on predictive log-likelihood vs the static-strength model and GSE's current score model, runtime vs MCMC on one season, and the calibration check (Efficient-VB posterior SDs vs MCMC SDs — median underestimation ratio reported).
gate: Gate (ADAPT->keep): predictive log-likelihood beats static-strength baseline by >= 0.01 nats/game on 2020-2024 AND runtime <= 5% of MCMC per season AND median posterior-SD underestimation <= 20% (ratio >= 0.8); fail any -> REJECT for production (keep as research prototype).

title: Balance asymmetry predicts subsequent injury
improvement: Add the re-injury cascade feature to GSE's availability model: replicate the prospective design on NFL data — cohort of player-weeks with a 'minor non-time-loss' designation (appears on injury report limited/questionable but plays) vs matched healthy controls; logistic/survival model for subsequent time-loss injury (missed games) within the next 8 weeks, adjusting for age, position, prior-season injuries, testing concentration in soft-tissue injuries (the mechanistic analogue of the paper's groin-pain cascade); serve 're-injury risk' annotations on injury-report content and availability-risk adjustments in fantasy projections for players carrying minor designations.
gate: ADAPT the cascade feature iff the NFL replication shows adjusted OR >= 2.0 for subsequent time-loss injury within 8 weeks of a minor designation (p<0.05) — a smaller but real analogue of the paper's 7.48; REJECT if OR < 1.3 (the cascade doesn't exist in NFL data, e.g. because NFL medical staffs already manage it).

title: Diversity is Key: Fantasy football dream teams under budget constraints
improvement: Lift the dominance-pruning preprocessor into GSE's DFS optimizer: before solving the weekly salary-cap MILP, apply the three-step reduction — per salary bucket and position keep only Pareto-optimal (salary, projection) players; drop any player strictly dominated by a cheaper-or-equal, higher-projected same-position peer; verify identical optima vs unpruned MILP on 20 slates (target >=10x solver-time reduction) — then test lineup-diversity constraints (salary/projection spread across bins, the paper's Algorithm 3) as a GPP construction heuristic, evaluating whether diversity-constrained lineups improve realized GPP ROI vs pure expected-points maximization (the paper's 72% regularity suggests optimal ex-post lineups are rarely stars-and-scrubs clumps).
gate: Adopt the pruning preprocessor iff it reproduces unpruned optima exactly on all test slates with >=10x speedup; adopt the diversity heuristic only iff diversity-constrained GPP sets show positive realized ROI improvement over unconstrained sets across the three-season window — otherwise keep it as a descriptive curiosity.

title: Pangu-Weather: A 3D High-Resolution System for Fast and Accurate Global Weather Forecast
improvement: Adopt two transferable patterns (not the weather model itself): (1) hierarchical temporal aggregation as a design pattern — train direct multi-week-ahead projection heads (1/2/4/8-week) and greedily compose them to minimize chained calls, instead of iterating a 1-week model 8 times (the paper quantifies naive 28x chaining's super-linear collapse; Pangu's 7x 24h chaining recovers >30% RMSE); (2) the RQE tail metric (Eq. 4, 90%->99.99% log-spaced percentiles) to audit whether GSE's weather inputs (wind especially) systematically underestimate extremes, with asymmetric tail-aware loss on the weather features in the totals head if the audit shows underestimation.
gate: ADAPT: the two transferable ideas (multi-lead-time greedy chaining; RQE tail auditing) are concrete, implementable, and map to real GSE subsystems (projection chaining, weather-adjusted totals). Not ADOPT: GSE will not train a weather model — the 3DEST architecture and ERA5 pipeline stay in the literature, not the repo.

title: flexBART: Flexible Bayesian regression trees with categorical predictors
improvement: Install flexBART (R package or ported C++ core) as GSE's Bayesian tabular learner and benchmark it as a drop-in replacement for XGBoost on tabular game/team/player tasks: features = team IDs, QB IDs, coach IDs (high-cardinality categoricals currently one-hot/target-encoded) + continuous EPA aggregates; first applications = 4th-down/prop probability models and referee-crew effects on totals (crew ID is the natural categorical input); training protocol = >=4 chains with R-hat checks, 2000+ iterations, batch serving (weekly precomputed posterior means + intervals) — then hybridize: use flexBART's posterior co-clustering matrix over team levels as a learned similarity kernel inside the existing XGBoost pipeline (team-similarity features from the Bayesian model, point predictions from the fast model).
gate: Adopt flexBART iff: (a) out-of-sample RMSE on 2024 improves >=3% over one-hot XGBoost (paper's benchmark gains were 5-30% on categorical-heavy data), AND (b) 80%/90% posterior intervals achieve empirical coverage within +-3 pp of nominal, with runtime acceptable for weekly batch; reject if gains <3% (check the DGP2 singleton-outlier caveat) or MCMC cost exceeds the batch window; reject the network extension if gs2/gs3 don't beat flexBART_unif on the schedule-graph task.

title: Going for GOAL: A Resource for Grounded Football Commentaries
improvement: Build 'GOAL-NFL': NFL highlight clips paired with broadcast commentary transcripts; implement the four grounding tasks with CLIP-style video-text encoders; use retrieval (the paper's strong task: R@1 63%) for a 'find the clip for this storyline' product feature; skip generation entirely (the paper's own numbers don't clear any usable bar) — and condition retrieval on game state (score, clock, down/distance) as an extra input, which should disambiguate visually similar moments (e.g., any touchdown) and is directly available in GSE's data.
gate: ADAPT the retrieval task into the clip-search product iff a CLIP-style modern baseline beats the paper's R@1 by >=5 points on GOAL-NFL pilot data; REJECT the generation task entirely.

title: Gambling on Momentum
improvement: Build a GSE 'narrative-fade' feature for in-play models: detect salient narrative events (NFL turnovers/big plays, scoring runs), measure the market's overreaction via odds-move vs model-WP-move divergence in the minutes after, and fade the overreaction — shade GSE's live probabilities against the narrative-driven steam (the paper's +12.7pp/40% overbetting figure calibrates the expected edge size); plus the ready-made content piece ('bettors believe in momentum, momentum doesn't exist') for in-play betting education — then run the cross-sport momentum audit: NFL pick-six vs methodical TD drive, NBA 12-0 runs, testing whether narrative-salience (not just score change) predicts overreaction size.
gate: ADAPT confirmed iff in GSE's odds data, post-goal odds moves systematically exceed model-implied WP moves in the narrative direction (overreaction) in at least one league with p<0.05; if no overreaction is found, the Bundesliga finding is market-specific — record that boundary.

title: Self-supervised Trajectory Representation Learning with Temporal Regularities and Travel Semantics (START)
