improvement: Build the START-style self-supervised trajectory encoder for NFL tracking: field-graph GNN (1-yd cells as nodes with region features; transfer probabilities from 7 seasons of tracking corpus capturing 'route-tree semantics'), TAT-Enc with play-clock/game-clock/down-distance embeddings + time-interval-aware attention (handles tracking dropouts); pretrain with span-masking (0.2-0.5s windows) + contrastive (trimming at snap/whistle, temporal shifting, dropout), L^pre = 0.6 L^mask + 0.4 L^con, d=256; downstream heads = play-outcome regression, route-family classification, frozen-embedding play retrieval — then go multi-agent: TAT-Enc jointly over all 22 agents with role embeddings, using 'same play, different coverage' hard negatives from FTN charting (true semantic negatives for free, avoiding the paper's false-hard-negative problem).
gate: ADOPT iff: (a) frozen-embedding route-family classification accuracy >= 15pp above the from-scratch Transformer on held-out weeks, OR (b) same-play-concept top-1 retrieval >= 40% (>=10pp over raw-DTW), OR (c) play-outcome regression MAE >= 5% below the no-embedding baseline; REJECT if none hold.

title: OpenFE: Automated Feature Generation with Expert-level Performance
improvement: Build 'GSE-OpenFE' as a batch feature-discovery service: game/team-game rows from nflverse 2006-2024, expansion operators restricted to time-safe ones (GroupByThenMean/Std/Min/Max/Count with expanding-window semantics keyed by team_id and season — computed only from prior games), binary ops on rate features, zero-guards; FeatureBoost (LightGBM base + GBDT residual fitter per candidate, delta = train-loss reduction, successive pruning over season blocks); Stage II attribution; survivors promoted to the feature store with provenance (operator, keys, window); offline weekly regeneration, features frozen per season — then make FeatureBoost time-aware and residual-targeted: score candidates per rolling-season block requiring delta > 0 in >=3 of 4 validation seasons (stability filter killing era-specific flukes), with permutation importance in validation-season log-loss as the final filter instead of MDI.
gate: ADOPT the discovered feature set iff test log-loss improves by >= 0.003 on the 2024 NFL held-out vs the hand-built baseline, with zero leakage violations (every GroupBy feature provably computable from pre-game data; audit via recomputation on a row-sample); REJECT if gain < 0.003, any surviving feature fails the time-safety audit, or validation-selected features degrade test (selection overfit).

title: Conditional Generative Modeling for Decision Making
improvement: Build 'GSE-DecisionDiffuser': state-only diffusion over game-state sequences (down/distance/yardline/score-diff/time per play — no play-type tokens; play outcomes implied by state transitions), conditioning on (a) normalized final margin, (b) total points, (c) binary flags (key injury, weather bucket); train conditional + unconditional noise models on nflverse 2006-2025 with classifier-free guidance; unbiased sampling (omega=0) for pricing distributions, conditional sampling (omega>0) for exotic-prop pricing (e.g., P(home wins by 13+) via return-conditioned generation, 'snow game' portfolio stress tests); drop the inverse-dynamics head — then compose MULTIPLE conditions at test time (margin AND total AND weather) for joint stress scenarios ('snow game + divisional underdog + backup QB'), replacing a combinatorial explosion of separate conditional models.
gate: ADOPT conditional state-diffusion iff on 2024 held-out: unconditional TVD <=5%/week AND ECE <=0.03 (same bar as the unconditional Diffuser) AND conditioning shifts sampled margins >=5 points in the conditioned direction without collapsing diversity (sampled std >=80% of unconditional std); REJECT if conditioning doesn't steer or unconditional quality trails the unconditional variant.

title: Predicting Football Match Outcomes with eXplainable Machine Learning and the Kelly Index
improvement: Add a 'market difficulty' classifier to the pick pipeline: compute a per-game Kelly-style index across US books (book odds / market mean x payout rate), classify games easy/medium/hard, train confidence calibration separately per class, and gate published picks (easy + engine confidence >=70% -> full unit; medium -> half unit or pass; hard -> pass); backtest on 2020-2024 NFL ATS vs closing lines — then replace the count-of-bookmakers rule with a continuous difficulty score (entropy of the de-vigged consensus + max Kelly index) and fit the confidence threshold by maximizing backtested Sharpe per season via walk-forward optimization, testing threshold stability across seasons.
gate: Adopt the difficulty classifier iff the backtest shows gated picks beat ungated on ROI by >=3 percentage points with CLV>0 over 2020-2024; keep as monitoring metric only otherwise.

title: Sequential Predictive Conformal Inference for Time Series (SPCI)
improvement: Build SPCI as GSE's second-order calibration layer for margin/total forecasts: after the engine produces point forecasts, collect trailing residuals, train a QRF (or gradient-boosted quantile model) on residual lags (last w in {4,8,16}, team-specific and league-pooled variants), publish intervals per the SPCI formula at alpha in {0.1, 0.2} with width-minimizing beta-hat; gate on autocorrelation — enable SPCI only when trailing-50-game residual lag-1 autocorrelation is significant (|rho-hat| > 0.15), else fall back to EnbPI/ACI — then augment the residual QRF with game-context features (rest differential, weather bucket, QB-change flag), a hybrid of CQR's X-adaptivity and SPCI's residual-adaptivity targeting GSE's regime-driven error spikes.
gate: ADAPT iff empirical coverage is within +-2pp of nominal AND mean width <= 85% of the EnbPI baseline on 2024-2025 (the paper's signature is width reduction — demand a material one); REJECT (fall back to EnbPI) if residual lag-1 autocorrelation is insignificant in GSE data (|rho-hat| < 0.1).

title: Converting College Football Point Spread Differentials to Probabilities
improvement: Build the NFL margin-multiplier matrix: historical exact-margin frequencies from nflverse 2000-2024 (~6,000 games); fit zero-mean normal for NFL multipliers (3: ~2.4, 7: ~1.9 with NFL-specific values), conditional SD ~= 13.5-13.86; margin x projection matrix (-60..60 x -40..40), column-normalized, pushes as half-win; wire into the engine (model projected spread + book spread + odds -> cover probability + edge -> Kelly sizing) — then make the multipliers state-dependent: separate vectors for divisional vs non-divisional, high vs low totals, late-season games (key-number landing rates vary with game script), and replace fixed SD=15 with heteroscedastic sigma(spread) estimated from conditional-margin data.
gate: Adopt iff the NFL matrix's cover probabilities are well-calibrated (Hosmer-Lemeshow p > 0.05 or reliability slope within 0.9-1.1 on 2015-2024) AND the edge>2% backtest shows positive ROI with CI excluding zero or positive mean CLV >= +0.5 points; reject if calibration slope < 0.8 or the backtest ROI CI includes zero with negative CLV.

title: A Bayesian Mixture Model Approach to Expected Possession Values in Rugby League
improvement: Port the Bayesian mixture EPV surface to NFL drives: ~40 expert centres on the field (own 10/25/40, mid, opp 40/25/10, goal line x left hash/middle/right hash + red-zone centres treated separately with linear weights), bilinear-interpolation fixed weights, Dirichlet-multinomial posterior per centre (conjugate — cheap in numpy; MCMC optional), data-driven alpha from historical NFL scoring rates by region, league -> team offense/defense hierarchy; precomputed 1-yard grid lookup serving, priors updated each offseason — then replace fixed bilinear weights with learned weights: a small NN (or GP kernel over (x,y)) outputting centre weights trained end-to-end against drive outcomes, with game-state covariates (down, distance, time, score diff) as inputs, converting the pure spatial surface into a joint spatial+state EPV model.
gate: ADOPT the surface as a GSE feature iff on the 2023-2024 holdout: (a) drive-points MSE <= nflfastR EP MSE (within 2%), AND (b) at least one per-outcome probability surface (e.g., FG probability in the 30-55 yard range) is better calibrated than the EP-implied outcome probabilities — >=5% lower Brier on that outcome class; REJECT as a standalone predictor if it underperforms nflfastR EP by >5% MSE; keep only as a visualisation tool if surfaces are qualitatively useful but numerically no better.

title: What Should Clubs Monitor to Predict Future Value of Football Players
improvement: Build NFL future-value models: per-position Lasso + RF predicting log(DK salary or projected fantasy points) N weeks ahead from per-snap/per-route normalized nflverse + FTN charting stats, with a team-strength anchor (log team implied total or unit grade) as the league-average-value analogue; rolling-origin time splits (fixing the paper's non-temporal CV), 5-fold within each origin; applications = dynasty trade value charts, award futures (OROY odds vs model), 'buy-low' flags where model value >> market salary — then fit age as a spline (not age + age^2) within each position model and test whether the spline beats the quadratic on veteran (age 29+) out-of-sample R2, since the spline should capture the late-career cliff fantasy markets misprice most.
gate: ADAPT the recipe iff per-position log-value models beat pooled + naive baselines on the §12 gate (per-position R2 >=3 points above pooled on >=3 of 4 skill positions AND beat the current-salary naive) with time-ordered validation; REJECT any claim that crowd-style valuations are the right target — use realized fantasy points/salaries, not crowd valuations.

title: Stochastic analysis of the Elo rating algorithm in round-robin tournaments
improvement: Add the K-factor scheduler to GSE's Elo module: K_k = s'*beta_{o,k} with beta from the paper's Eq. 71, v-hat estimated each offseason from the prior season's final rating spread (M=32, k = games played so far) — large K early (fast convergence), decaying through the season; recompute R for the NFL schedule (replace uniform Eq. 14 with the empirical matchup-frequency matrix), re-derive tau1 for a preseason burn-in (ratings provisional before k ~= 3*tau1 games), and enforce K_k < 2*v-hat*s' as a hard cap — then run the 2x2 with the luck-capped link (paper 0576): fixed/scheduled K x standard/capped link on the walk-forward protocol, shipping both only if the interaction is super-additive in the heavy-favorite tail, otherwise keeping the cheaper one.
gate: ADOPT the scheduled K iff it beats fixed-K on pooled 2015-2025 log-loss by >=0.001 AND wins the first-6-weeks split (early-season adaptivity is the mechanism; a win only late-season is suspect); ADAPT (scheduler for weeks 1-6, fixed K after) if it wins early-season only; REJECT if no improvement — the NFL's non-round-robin schedule may break the R assumption beyond what the trace approximation tolerates.

title: 1171 Anomaly Detection using Ensemble Classification and Evidence Theory
improvement: Stand up the per-game ensemble conflict monitor + abstention rule: for each game's component-model probability vectors compute (a) UQ_P = Pi_i(1-p_i(win)) and (b) Dempster-Shafer conflict mass b_k from pairwise evidence combination (evidence m_i = [p_i*w_i, (1-p_i)*w_i, 1-w_i], w_i = trailing-season log-loss skill weight); calibrate dual thresholds tau_DS, tau_Y on trailing seasons so flagged games are those where the unflagged ensemble has historically negative CLV — abstain (no pick) or cap stake on flagged games; pool-selection audit: pre-cut models dominated on trailing-season skill, class specialization (home-favorite/underdog/divisional), and pairwise log-odds correlation diversity — then make the thresholds regime-adaptive (calibrated per early/late season and model-market disagreement context) and extend the evidence frame to a power set of regime labels (injury + weather + rest) with Yager conflict on the universal set as the 'compound anomaly' signal.
gate: ADAPT the anomaly-abstention rule iff on 2025 data, games flagged by the dual-threshold conflict rule have statistically significantly worse ensemble Brier than unflagged games AND abstaining on them improves full-season log-loss; REJECT the raw anomaly thresholds if the flagged/unflagged Brier gap is insignificant; REJECT the full DSET/Yager machinery in favor of the simpler 1169 disagreement dividend if the dual-threshold rule adds nothing over sum w_i D_G(p*||p_i).

title: Parametric Post-Processing of Dual-Resolution Precipitation Forecasts
improvement: Build the weather-for-totals calibration layer: take raw stadium precipitation/wind ensemble forecasts, fit CSG EMOS (or censored Gaussian/logistic for wind) with CRPS-minimizing rolling windows, using semi-local clustering across NFL stadiums (cluster by climate regime and ensemble spread characteristics) to share parameters where single-stadium history is thin; feed the calibrated predictive distributions into the totals model as uncertainty-aware weather features, tracking CRPSS per stadium as the calibration health metric — then replace the fixed gamma with a learned per-cluster mixture (gamma + point mass), test online CRPS-gradient updates for non-stationary regimes, and extend to joint precipitation-wind-temperature post-processing for a full stadium weather state.
gate: ADAPT: CRPS-fitted censored EMOS with semi-local clustering is a production-grade calibration recipe that fills a documented hole in GSE's calibration stack and directly feeds weather-driven totals; validate on public NOAA/GEFS ensembles (match a local-quantile-mapping CRPSS baseline with shorter training history) then confirm totals-model log-loss improvement on the port.

title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
improvement: Apply the DreamerV3 robustness toolkit to the GSE-Dream latent simulator: categorical latents (e.g., 32 categories x 32 dims) for z_t to capture multimodality of 4th-down decisions, turnover regimes, garbage-time scripts; symlog-transform all vector observation inputs (EPA, yardage, score diff) with symexp-twohot loss for the score/EPA reward predictor (EPA is heavy-tailed — exactly the failure mode symlog fixes); KL balancing + free bits (1 nat floor) with beta=(1,1,0.1); continue predictor c_t for drive/game termination (end of half, turnover on downs, game end); 1% uniform mixed into categoricals; fixed-hyperparameter discipline (one config across all teams/seasons first) — then learn a team-conditional prior p(z_t | h_t, team_offense_emb, team_defense_emb) so the dynamics predictor bakes in matchup strength instead of rediscovering it from score context, testing on 2024 games with pregame spread >=7.
gate: ADOPT the DreamerV3 toolkit into the GSE simulator stack iff variant (B) improves one-step-ahead log-likelihood >=10% over the naive variant (A) on 2024 held-out plays AND reaches the 1942 gates (TVD <=5% per week, ECE <=0.03); REJECT if (B) shows no significant gain over (A) after <=2 weeks of tuning — the stabilizers are only worth their complexity if they move the metrics; the actor-critic half stays out of scope.

title: DAG Learning on the Permutahedron (DAGuerreotype)
improvement: Learn the topological ordering of GSE's team-strength indicators with DAGuerreotype: nflverse team-season aggregates (cross-sectional, ~35 indicators, standardized), DAGuerreotype from the public repo with GSE's own per-target gradient-boosted regressor as the edge estimator (each indicator predicted from candidate parents under the current ordering — optimizing the ordering against GSE's real predictive loss, not least squares); Bayesian optimization over sparsity/regularization on 2015-2023, ordering per season-block aggregated by rank-stability; output = consensus topological ordering constraining downstream NOTEARS/PCMCI+ runs (edges must respect the learned order), shrinking their search space — then learn the ordering jointly with GSE's actual game-outcome loss as the edge subroutine, turning causal ordering discovery into a feature-selection objective end-to-end (hypothesis: outcome-loss orderings rank market features late, efficiency fundamentals early).
gate: ADOPT the learned ordering as a constraint layer iff: (a) Kendall's tau >= 0.6 between orderings learned on odd vs even seasons; (b) order-constrained NOTEARS matches unconstrained Brier within 0.002 while using <=70% of edges; (c) >=80% of high-confidence order pairs respect football directionality (pressure before sacks before defensive EPA); REJECT if tau < 0.5 (no stable causal ordering) or if only the Gaussian equal-variance likelihood variant converges (estimator-dependence failure).

title: Sport Task: Fine Grained Action Detection and Classification of Table Tennis Strokes from Videos for MediaEval 2022
improvement: Define 'GSE-ActionBench': an internal benchmark with the same two subtasks for NFL events (pass-play type from trimmed clips; drive segmentation from full game video), scored with global+per-class accuracy and COCO-style temporal mAP (0.5-0.95) + frame-wise IoU; adopt the 'forbid pre-training on prior benchmark years' rule to keep yearly comparisons honest; require working-notes-style method documentation per model version — and add a third subtask the paper lacks: boundary-precision scoring (mean absolute boundary error in frames) for the detection task, since GSE's downstream products (clip extraction, highlight boundaries) care about exact cut points, not just IoU-thresholded mAP.
gate: The internal action benchmark is only useful iff it reproduces the paper's metric behavior: a trivial baseline must score near chance on classification (validating task difficulty) and a strong model must show the long-tail gap (per-class accuracy spread >= 30 points between head and tail classes), mirroring the paper's 2021 74.2-vs-20.4 dynamic.

title: View fusion via a Bayesian interpretation of Black-Litterman for portfolio allocation
improvement: Fuse GSE's correlated pick-generating signals (engine model, market-implied/CLV, analyst adjustments, LLM panels) with covariance intersection / inverse covariance intersection instead of naive precision-weighting: GSE's sources share information (market feeds into engine and vice versa), so precision-weighting would be overconfident — the paper's PW-underperformance is direct evidence; track the epistemic/aleatoric decomposition (eq. 34) separately (model-uncertainty vs market noise) rather than as one variance number — then blend CI/ICI with adaptive fusion weights tracking which source is currently best (mAFTER-style per ledger 0786), combining correlation-robustness with time-adaptivity, and use CU sparingly for contradictory signals (e.g., engine vs market on injury-news games).
gate: ADOPT the ICI/CU/CI fusion iff it beats precision-weighting and simple averaging by >= 1% log-loss improvement over the best single source on the reproducible test (N correlated pick-probability sources on GSE's historical pick set, Diebold-Mariano test), with consistency (fused variance not understated vs empirical).

title: Near-Minimax-Optimal Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning with CVaR
improvement: Deploy Bernstein-UCB CVaR bandit for weekly pick-category allocation: arms = pick categories (spread-high-conf, spread-mid, ML-dog, total-over, total-under, prop-tier; A~=6-10), reward r_k = realized profit in units mapped to [0,1]; maintain per-category empirical shortfall with Bernstein bonus (delta=0.05, tau=0.25); weekly: compute optimistic CVaR f-hat_k per category, soft-allocate posting slots to top-f-hat categories (top-3, not winner-take-all, to keep exploration); sliding 8-week window for N_k and mu-hat_k (sports aren't stationary, the paper assumes stationarity); the f-hat_k values serve as the audit trail ('why we leaned totals this week') — then make it contextual: shortfall estimates conditional on game context (home/away, divisional, weather flag) via per-category quantile regression instead of the unconditional empirical CDF.
gate: ACCEPT iff on the 2022-2025 walk-forward: realized CVaR_0.25(weekly profit) >= 1.15x best baseline AND mean weekly profit >= 0.9x the 'post-all' baseline (tail protection may cost <=10% of mean) AND number of posted picks >= 60% of post-all volume (must not degenerate to posting nothing); REJECT otherwise, or if the bonus term dominates selection for >50% of weeks (then it's just exploring, not selecting).

title: Inferring Player Location in Sports Matches: Multi-Agent Spatial Imputation from Limited Observations
improvement: Rebuild the multi-agent spatial imputation model for NFL: replace soccer roles/event types with down, distance, yard line, play type (run/pass/play-action), personnel grouping, formation, pre-snap motion, score differential, time remaining; prev/next play involvement per player (targets/carries/tackles) as the on-ball-event analogue; train on public Big Data Bowl tracking as ground truth with nflverse play-by-play as the sparse event input; build a causal (filter) variant for in-play use alongside the smoother and measure the accuracy cost; add a probabilistic head (per-agent Gaussian or ensemble) since point estimates are insufficient for calibrated downstream use — then build the Probabilistic Agent Imputer (per-agent mixture-density output, evaluated on calibration via rank histograms and downstream field-control uncertainty bands) and test cross-league transfer (zero-shot on a held-out league/season) to measure how much of 'team structure' is universal.
gate: ACCEPT as ADAPT pending the §12 transfer test: (a) test mean Euclidean error within ~15% of the paper's 6.88 m on comparable soccer data, or (b) on NFL data, per-play all-22 imputation error documented by position group with the causal variant no worse than 1.5x the smoother; standing gate: imputed positions must never be presented as measured tracking in any public content or model input without per-role error bounds attached, and the smoother must not be used for anything resembling live prediction; demote to REJECT if the NFL feature rebuild fails to beat a time-scaled interpolation baseline by >=40%.

title: Black-Box Batch Active Learning for Regression
improvement: Build the black-box active-learning acquisition pipeline for GSE's regression heads (spread margin, total, team yardage): maintain a small ensemble K=10 (or reuse existing GBM bagged folds as a free virtual ensemble), compute centered prediction vectors per pool game, build the empirical predictive covariance Gram matrix, and run black-box BADGE (k-means++ on prediction-disagreement embeddings) and black-box Core-Set for weekly charting queues — needs only predictions, so it works unchanged across the heterogeneous stack; monitor the failure signal (if inter-member disagreement collapses, e.g., late season, fall back to uniform/geometric sampling); divide the acquisition score by charting cost c(game) for the knapsack rule (ledger 2008) — then test disagreement-weighted virtual ensembles: weight each member's contribution to the predictive covariance by its validation-set skill instead of uniform q_k = 1/K.
gate: ADOPT black-box BADGE iff it matches or beats white-box BADGE on 2024 held-out margin RMSE at equal batch size (delta-RMSE <= 0 — no accuracy cost for dropping gradient access) AND runs >= 3x faster per acquisition round, with the win replicated on a second head (totals); REJECT if black-box underperforms white-box by > 0.05 RMSE points (the Fisher-kernel approximation is carrying real signal), or if pool disagreement collapses so black-box ~= uniform (their CatBoost failure mode).

title: Transformer-Based Neural Marked Spatio Temporal Point Process Model for Football Match Events Analysis
improvement: Build the NFL neural drive point process: nflverse play-by-play 2018-2025; discretize each play into marks (time-since-last-play, field zone in 20 zones: 5 downfield bands x 4 lateral thirds, play type in 6-8 classes: run/short pass/deep pass/screen/turnover/penalty/kick); trailing-40-play history (truncate at drive boundaries for the drive-score variant); transformer encoder -> history vector -> dependent heads t->zone->play-type (scaled RMSE on seconds + cross-entropies); derive the 'drive utilization score' (DUS) adapting HAS with NFL weights (explosive play = 10, successful play = 5, failed play = 0; red-zone area weight 10) with exponential recency decay — a drive-level efficiency metric using no scoring data for content ('most efficient drives that didn't score') and as a WP-model feature — then replace the hand-chosen HAS weights and decay with learned parameters (fit by maximizing DUS's correlation with held-out team offensive efficiency under CV) and run the learned-excitation-kernel variant from ledger 0420 §14 on the same harness (head-to-head 'momentum' formalisms).
gate: ADOPT the NFL point-process model iff it beats the AR(2) baseline by >= 0.10 total loss AND the LSTM baseline by >= 0.03 on the 2024 season holdout; ADOPT the DUS metric for content/features iff its team-level correlation with offensive EPA/play is >= 0.70 on 2024; REJECT the whole approach if the transformer fails to beat the LSTM baseline — the paper's core claim is the architecture win, and without it there is no reason to carry the complexity.

title: NBA2Vec: Dense Feature Representations of NBA Players
improvement: Port NBA2Vec as GSE's learned player/lineup representation layer: play-by-play with 10 on-court players per play and a discrete outcome taxonomy (~20 classes); train the embedding + MLP model (embedding dim 8-32, hidden 128, cross-entropy) on all non-holdout games; validate on held-out games (mean KL per matchup; require the plateau-by-30-plays behavior as a sanity check); export frozen player embeddings as features into the fantasy/prop projection stack (concatenated with box-score priors); refresh on a rolling window (last 2 seasons) to capture form/role drift — then replace mean-pooling with an attention/SET-transformer over the 10 embeddings (captures who-guards-whom) and add a temporal component (rolling embeddings).
gate: Gate (ADAPT): the embedding-plus-MLP predicts play-outcome distributions with mean KL ~= 0.3 on held-out playoff games, embeddings recover known roles, and the matchup optimizer produces sensible orderings; adopt as ADAPT (weakened only by missing baselines); improvement success = held-out KL <= 0.25 (>= ~17% relative improvement) with the same 25-game validation protocol.

title: Wasserstein-Kelly Portfolios
improvement: Rebuild the paper's experiment first (10 random S&P 500 stocks, train 2019, OOS 2020-01-01 to 2023-02-20, delta in {0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4}, 1,000 repetitions; verify the robust portfolios' OOS Sharpe and max drawdown dominate standard Kelly's on average), then run the GSE application on the pick history (Neon picks, model v5.2.7): walk-forward robust-Kelly vs standard fractional-Kelly staking, scoring log-wealth and max drawdown per season, with delta chosen on a rolling validation window — the expectation from the paper: robust Kelly sacrifices a little growth in stable regimes for materially smaller drawdowns across regime changes (season boundaries, model updates); quantify the exchange rate.
gate: ADAPT: Wasserstein-robust Kelly is the tail-aware staking layer for GSE's pick portfolio; adopt the walk-forward protocol as the standing staking test — robust Kelly ships iff the walk-forward shows materially smaller max drawdown across regime changes at an acceptable growth exchange rate (the paper's graphical claim replicated on GSE's own picks); otherwise keep fractional Kelly.

title: Predicting Elite NBA Lineups Using Individual Player Order Statistics
improvement: Replicate the elite-lineup order-statistic technique on NFL DFS: replace the 28 NBA stats with per-player fantasy-relevant stats; define the target as GPP-winning-lineup membership or top-1% lineup finish; expand each slate's player pool into order-statistic predictors per candidate lineup (sorted by projection, ceiling, ownership, leverage); train a diverse classifier set; apply the unanimous-consent rule to generate a high-precision short list of lineups for final optimizer seeding; calibrate the precision/recall trade-off against contest payout structure (top-heavy GPPs favor the unanimity filter) — then replace unanimity with a calibrated agreement-threshold (k-of-7 votes) tuned per contest payout curve, and add interaction features (teammate/opponent overlap) to recover some of the sacrificed recall; test on NFL showdown and classic slates.
gate: ADAPT: elite-lineup identification without shared-court history is a genuinely transferable DFS/stacks technique, and the unanimous-consent ensemble is a portable high-precision filter for any GPP lineup pipeline; first reproduce the paper's 86.7%-level test precision vs the 62.1% prevalence baseline on one NBA season of public data, then confirm optimizer ROI improvement with vs without unanimity filtering on one NFL DFS slate.

title: Learning Representation for Anomaly Detection of Vehicle Trajectories
improvement: Build the semantic autoencoder for NFL trajectories: 10Hz tracking, plays with field context (yard lines, down/distance as the 'map graph' analog); train the semantic AAE with the latent partitioned into intention (route-concept class, charted), physicality/aggressiveness (speed/accel-derived), residual; decoder reconstructs trajectories (smooth-L1), discriminators regularize partitions; deploy two heads: (a) reconstruction-error anomaly flag for data QA, (b) semantic factors as features for GSE prop models; supervised contrastive variant: contrast normal plays vs synthetically perturbed plays (PGD-style waypoint jitter) to harden the trajectory forecaster — then switch to football-native anomaly synthesis (swap a player's trajectory with a different play's same-position trajectory — context-inconsistent but realistic) and run the adversarial loop: train the ball-carrier forecaster on AAE-flagged hardest legitimate plays to test whether 'legitimate hard examples' improve tail performance.
gate: ADOPT iff: (a) anomaly-detection ROC AUC >= 0.85 on synthetic perturbations (vs <= 0.70 for the raw-acceleration baseline), AND (b) the intention partition achieves AMI >= 0.30 with charted route concepts; REJECT if (a) fails.

title: NFL Career Success as Predicted by NFL Scouting Combine
improvement: Use the combine paper as a NEGATIVE prior in GSE's rookie model: cap combine-feature weights in rookie-season projections — do not let 40-yard dash / 3-cone standouts move rookie fantasy projections materially; draft-market angle: fade rookies whose draft slot was driven by combine testing over college production for rookie-season props (rookie of the year, season-long yardage props), favor productive college players with mediocre testing; concrete rule: rookie projection blend weight = alpha*college production + beta*draft position + gamma*combine with gamma <= 0.1 and 3-cone excluded or signed near-zero for RB/WR/TE, broad jump allowed small positive weight (only drill with any success signal) — then run position-specific combine validity (per position group with position-relevant success metrics) to test whether the null is a pooling artifact and whether any drill x position cell has real predictive power worth a nonzero weight.
gate: ADAPT iff Test 1 replicates (combine predicts matriculation at 0.78-0.88 accuracy but snaps R2 < 0.25 — the negative prior stands regardless of Test 2); REJECT only if combine metrics strongly predict success on modern classes (R2 >= 0.35 without production features), which would overturn the paper; the adaptation is a modeling constraint, not a predictor — judge it on whether GSE's rookie projections avoid the combine trap, not on a new edge.
